snippet.title: City God Alice – Official Trailer(EN)
snippet.description:
A supernatural RPG inspired by Taiwanese folklore and City God myths.

City God Alice is a story-driven indie game that blends Taiwanese folklore, supernatural mystery, and turn-based combat. It follows the intertwined fate of Alice, the Proxy City God, and a temple caretaker with only one year left to live.
If he fails to uncover the source of the curse within that year, he will lose his life—and become the next City God.

👉 Add it to your Steam wishlist to support us!
🎮 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4045810
